scope: Worker dispatcher, PostgreSQL wakeups, concurrent claims and capacity/state/money regression. Synthetic data only.

suites.note: Repeated standalone and included in PostgreSQL suite; count unique once.

limits: Claims use the production function in-process; HTTP claim transit and SDK startup are excluded.
Cold means fresh worker database connection, not a cold application process.
Baseline reproduces the former 500ms dispatch sleep against the same current production claim implementation.
Isolated fixture rate-limit cache is reset outside each measurement.

invariants_verified: NOTIFY emitted only on commit; rollback silent
LISTEN before empty check prevents lost wakeup
Two waiters claim one execution once; replay returns identical attempt/token
No notification uses exactly two durable checks at bounded timeout
Worker rechecks authorization after wake; revoked connection cannot claim
Listener limit uses bounded fallback; legacy claim remains immediate
Actual Django ASGI handles two blocked claim requests and concurrent inference HTTP independently
Capacity exclusions, uncertain provider accounting and sandbox releases retain existing invariants
Worker transport retry preserves claim_id; no VM allocation for text jobs
